title: Theoretical Probability
summary: Equally likely outcomes, complementary events, and probability with coins, dice and cards.
objectives: I can find the probability of an event with equally likely outcomes.
I can use P(not E) = 1 − P(E).
I can solve problems with dice, coins and cards.
misconceptions: After five heads, a tail is more likely.
Sums of two dice are equally likely.
A probability can be more than 1.
